tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. This sits alongside the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and no build type is exempt. It also notes the separate recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.

The "verification on all builds" decision (#26) is current. Two earlier records (#24 and #27) are retired, so the doc doesn't mention them. I couldn't read their content, since retired records aren't served.

The first attempt to write the file through a shell heredoc failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the file-write tool instead, and it was created without problems.
